page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology. The instance is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, providing 64 dedicated vCPUs. System memory is configured at 128.0 GB, yielding a memory allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core.

Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support substantial network throughput across compute clusters. The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for data persistence. Hardware accelerators such as GPUs are not included in this configuration.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio targets workloads that require core count over large memory footprints. The configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for execution-heavy operations where processing capacity drives hardware utilization. Recommended applications include batch processing pipelines, continuous integration systems, mathematical modeling, and parallel compute nodes.

Local storage is not included, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistence, and no dedicated GPU hardware is present. The system delivers a high density of processing power relative to memory allocation, offering solid qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy parallel workloads. It is well suited for batch execution, software compilation, continuous integration, simulation tasks, and high-throughput web service deployments.
